title: Get subnetwork from INDRA database — getSubnetworkFromIndra
code: getSubnetworkFromIndra(   input,   protein_level_data = NULL,   pvalueCutoff = NULL,   statement_types = c("IncreaseAmount", "DecreaseAmount"),   paper_count_cutoff = 1,   evidence_count_cutoff = 1,   correlation_cutoff = 0.3,   sources_filter = NULL,   logfc_cutoff = NULL,   force_include_proteins = NULL,   force_include_other = NULL )

title: Get subnetwork from INDRA database — getSubnetworkFromIndra
text: input output groupComparison function's comparisionResult table, contains list proteins corresponding p-values, logFCs, along additional HGNC ID HGNC name columns protein_level_data output dataProcess function's ProteinLevelData table, contains list proteins corresponding abundances.  Used annotating correlation information applying correlation cutoffs. pvalueCutoff p-value cutoff filtering. Default NULL, .e. filtering statement_types list interaction types filter .  Equivalent statement type INDRA.  Default c("IncreaseAmount", "DecreaseAmount"). paper_count_cutoff number papers filter . Default 1. evidence_count_cutoff number evidence filter paper. E.g. paper may 5 sentences describing interaction vs 1 sentence.  Default 1. correlation_cutoff protein_level_abundance NULL, apply cutoff edges correlation less specified cutoff.  Default 0.3 sources_filter filtering specific sources.  Default filter, .e. NULL. Otherwise, list, e.g. c('reach', 'medscan'). logfc_cutoff absolute log fold change cutoff filtering proteins. proteins |logFC| greater value retained. Default NULL, .e. logFC filtering. force_include_proteins character vector protein identifiers exempt filtering steps. proteins retained regardless p-value, logFC, filtering criteria. Default NULL, .e. exemptions. force_include_other character vector identifiers include network, regardless ids input data. formatted "namespace:identifier", e.g. "HGNC:1234" "CHEBI:4911".
